decks.description: Celebrity Theater orchestra level, Fortunes Casino, Martini Bar, Rendezvous Lounge, Photo Gallery, and lower level of the Main Restaurant.

features.name: Celebrity Theater (Orchestra)
features.description: Middle orchestra tier of the three-deck production theater.

features.name: Cinema & Conference Center
features.description: Dedicated movie cinema screening first-run films and hosting lectures.

features.name: Fortunes Casino
features.description: Exciting Vegas-style gaming venue featuring craps, blackjack, roulette, poker, and slots.

features.description: Cocktails and spirits right beside the casino gaming tables.

features.name: Rendezvous Lounge

features.name: Photo Gallery & Studio

features.name: Trellis Restaurant (Lower Level)

decks.description: Celebrity Theater balcony, Galleria Boutiques, Art Gallery, Café al Bacio, Blu, Tuscan Grille, and upper level of the Main Restaurant.

features.description: Balcony tier of the three-deck production theater.

features.name: Galleria Boutiques

features.name: Art Gallery
features.description: Fine art gallery with original paintings, sculptures, and live art auctions.

features.name: Grand Foyer (Upper Level)
features.description: Top floor of the Grand Foyer atrium with views down to the onyx staircase.

features.name: Café al Bacio & Gelateria

features.name: Cellar Masters
